notes.title: Big plans for 2017!
notes.content:
We're celebrating the launch of Quantum Engine with a huge update containing lots of new modes to help visualize chemistry for everyone, here's a brief overview of what's coming up very soon: 

    Many simulations
    Polarity explained
    Tons of new animations including all five major chemical reactions
    More facts & videos!

 A whole new look into Quantum Mechanics with lots of animations and simulations: 

       Bohr's model of the atom
       Young’s experiment and matter waves
       Quantum superposition
       Schrödinger’s cat
       Nuclear fusion
       Entanglement
